items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: No, they didn't invent them, but it was the first time I heard them play Bach melody.

ctx.x: Ninths and flat fives, which -- well, those things had gone on before, hadn't they? I mean, they didn't invent the flat five or the automatic 13's.
No, they didn't invent them, but it was the first time I heard them play Bach melody. That's what's fascinating to me.
